sources.snippet: use this text encoder with the anima model This text encoder behave different than the text encoder that many use with anima model. one of them is that it follow your prompt way closer. the quality of image (style) is way worse, but if you care about a text encoder that follow your prompt way closer than it is worth it IMO.
